thread:
Alex: Heads up — saw a customer report where an aborted streaming request + auto-retry that included a toolcall ended up double-charging. Console shows ~1.8x tokens billed vs expected.
Riley: Reproducer on my laptop: client disconnect mid-stream -> runtime retried the last chunk as a new request without the original stream_session metadata. Billing counted both attempts.
Alex: Logs (sanitized):\n```\n2026-02-28T15:12:10Z billing: stream_id=sr-9b1 tokens_charged=240 event=stream_abort
2026-02-28T15:12:11Z runtime: retry start new_req=rn-7f2 parent_stream=sr-9b1? false
2026-02-28T15:12:12Z billing: new_req=rn-7f2 tokens_charged=240 event=stream_fragment
2026-02-28T15:12:13Z billing: invoice_total=480 customer=acct-17
```\nSam: Sounds like toolcall idempotency + stream boundary metadata aren't preserved across retry. If a toolcall happened mid-stream we might be replaying it.
Joy: We dedupe toolcalls by toolcall_id normally, but the SDK/runtime currently doesn't attach toolcall_id to retried fragments consistently. Streaming retry forks lose the association.
Nora: Telemetry makes this worse — console groups by request_id; retries get new request_id so it's invisible that two billed entries are the same logical session. We need a stable session identifier.
BillingBot: :warning: Alert: suspected duplicate-charge pattern detected for acct-17. Recommended temporary mitigation: flag invoices containing duplicate model+prompt hashes within 120s for manual review.
Riley: Auto-crediting will hide churn. Better approach: deterministic dedupe in billing: prefer idempotency token from SDK or server-assigned session_id attached to all retries.
Alex: Proposal: add an opt-in header "x-stream-session-id" the SDK sets. Runtime will propagate it to any retry and to toolcall invocations. Billing will dedupe tokens by (session_id, toolcall_id) within a configurable window. Rollout as an opt-in flag first.
Sam: For observability we should add metrics: billed_tokens_per_session, attempted_tokens_per_session, duplicate_tokens_detected. Console UX: per-route toggle "dedupe by session_id" and a report that surfaces potentially affected invoices.
Joy: I'll prototype runtime events: session_attach and toolcall_attach so we can validate across a 2-week window before enabling auto-dedupe. We'll emit span attributes too.
Nora: I'll write the analytics query for the last 90 days to find likely duplicates and create a dashboard. @Matt can infra start ingesting session_id into the metrics pipeline?
Matt: SG. I'll add ingestion for session_id and a billing service flag that suppresses charges for duplicates within 2 minutes for same (session_id, toolcall_id). We'll gate the flag behind feature-flag and telemetry checks.
Alex: Nice. Also let's surface suggested credits in the console as drafts rather than auto-applying for at least the first week of rollout :eyes:
